title: R8 verifier-isolation audit: enumerate every builder-writable seam a gate reads (working tree vs committed tree, probe anchors, pre-staged verdict files) and close the residuals so attestation SHAs are minted by the harness only
summary: Attestation/SHA mismatch contributed to 3/9 recent FAILs (1603/1604/1605) and cycle 1595's probe-quarantine anchor reuse. Evidence: Berkeley RDI agent-eval checklist — a 10-line conftest.py 'resolves' 100% of SWE-bench Verified; 'the system under test must not be able to read, write, or influence the evaluation environment'.
root_cause: Some gates still read artifacts the builder can write (explanation doc, pre-staged acs-verdict.json before #529, probe anchors).
fix: Inventory (doc) + close: gates evaluate the committed tree in a detached worktree; attestation SHAs computed by the harness from that tree; agent-authored copies are advisory.
acceptance: docs/architecture doc lists every gate input with its writer and trust class.
No gate reads an agent-writable path as authority (regression test over the inventory).
